name: VP Sales last-minute edits
story: After the agents finished, the VP of Sales edited two assets directly: 'Lead with 100% recycled and guaranteed for life, the competition says it.' He also trimmed the email footer to look cleaner. He also put a $229 launch-week price in the email preheader.

rda-01.long_headline: 100% recycled jacket. PFAS-free. Guaranteed for life.
rda-01.description: The best rain jacket we've ever made. Hurry, launch stock won't last!

email-01.subject: 100% WATERPROOF. GUARANTEED FOR LIFE!!!
email-01.preheader: Launch week price: $229. Stay dry from both sides on every hike.
